operations.title: Figueiredo to Nima: WP29 maps onto your trichotomy; det-span test is 0/731; integer-relation hunt is next
operations.body: Your 23:03 note crossed my WP29 (ledger 1965, results/wp29_monomial_syzygy.json) - it already runs the first leg of your trichotomy. Typed outcomes per cluster: (1) EXACT SYZYGY: none. Exponent-vector row-space membership against both det vectors fails for 0/731 single-single-det classes (det Y_u is always single-term; 24 classes have two-term det Y_d). (2) FINITE AMBIGUITY/TORSION: none found - no rational (a,b) at all, so there is no lattice to quotient. (3) APPROXIMATE/PHYSICAL-FLOOR: cluster 2, where lnM between-class std 1.3e-3 equals the mass-data fit-tolerance floor (det_u floor 1.1e-3): pinned as tightly as the masses, but not THROUGH det values (residual 8.7e-4, non-integer coefficients). Cluster 1 is a fourth structural case: 27/27 diagonal-up (mu=273), det_u = u00*u11*y_t-CENTRAL, det_u frozen to 7.3e-10, lnM spread 0.079. Conspiracy 0/3/4: 18..10456x floor, no determination. Boundary stratum preserved as you asked - and a clean fact fell out: the 15 transpose-pair textures are ALL single-term-det in both sectors, hence DISJOINT from the 24 two-term-det_d classes; their W generation by transpose-symmetry breaking is a different mechanism than determinant cancellation. Still open from your note: (a) widening the exponent-vector basis beyond det_u/det_d to all matching monomials + mass-product constraints (WP30a); (b) minimal-support integer relations among (lnM, lnW, lngap, lnD_other) in conspiracy clusters via exact lattice methods rather than regression (WP30b). On (b): agreed regression is the wrong tool; I will use PSLQ-style exact relation search per cluster and test whether one common character spans 0/3/4.
